methodology.missing_values: null/absence = not published, outside scope or unavailable; never replaced by zero.
methodology.enterprise_scope: ICT usage indicators use exact NACE sections C–J and L–N where Eurostat publishes them; financial sector K is outside this direct enterprise-survey benchmark.
methodology.dii: Year-specific official DII versions are retained; 2020 is calculated as 100 − very-low DII, following the source construction used in the Bulgarian panel.
methodology.productivity: Real GVA (2020 prices, million euro) × 1000 / hours worked (thousand hours).
methodology.ranking: Country ranking uses EU member states with valid values only. EU27_2020 is an aggregate benchmark and is not ranked.
